text.title: LLM-Friendly Architecture (Software Developer) — Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from a committed audit script to a decision that names files: pin the line limit and SHA, run the audit, rank oversized files with a split each, list depth violations, barrels and wildcard imports, score naming with offenders, find inline data, reconcile CLAUDE.md, then decide and wire the audit into CI.

step.name: pin-limit-and-sha
step.input: The repo at the commit to audit; `templates/llm-arch-audit.sh` or the project's committed equivalent.
step.action: Record `repo.url`, `repo.commit_sha` (`git rev-parse HEAD`), `repo.source_root`; set the `line_limit` input (default 250, never above 300) and, if the project uses namespace imports deliberately, the `namespace_import_allowlist`.
step.decision-gate: A line limit above 300 is rejected (r-file-size-histogram-with-threshold).

step.name: run-audit-script
step.action: Run it on the pinned SHA; copy the exact command into `audit.command` and `evidence[]`, and the SHA into `evidence[]`.
step.output: Raw audit output; `audit.command` and two `evidence[]` entries.
step.decision-gate: A list typed from memory is not an audit (r-audit-is-reproducible-command).

step.name: rank-oversized-files
step.input: The "files exceeding" section of the audit output; `wc -l` over the source tree.
step.action: Fill `file_size.histogram` (buckets such as 0-100, 101-250, 251-500, 501+) and `file_size.oversized[]` sorted by lines descending, each with a `proposed_split` that names the target files: data to `src/data/`, hooks to `hooks/`, pure functions to `utils/`.
step.decision-gate: "Split later" or a `Foo2.tsx` proposal is rejected (fm-01).

step.name: list-depth-barrels-wildcards
step.input: `find <source_root> -type f | awk -F/ 'NF-1 > 3'`; the barrel section of the audit; Ruff `F403`/`F405` or `eslint-plugin-import` `import/no-namespace` output.
step.action: Fill `directory_depth.violations[]` with each path deeper than 3 levels (feature folders deeper than 2) and its depth; `barrels[]` with every `export * from` or re-export-only `index.ts`; `wildcard_imports.lint` and `hits[]` with every star or namespace import outside the allow-list.
step.decision-gate: Barrels and wildcard imports go first in the decision; they invalidate every other navigation finding (r-no-barrel-reexports, r-explicit-imports-no-wildcards, r-directory-depth-cap).

step.name: score-naming-with-offenders
step.input: The file list; the rubric (file name equals primary export; PascalCase components, `use-*` hooks, kebab-case utils; no `utils2` / `misc` / `helpers` / `common` / `stuff`; no unexplained abbreviations).
step.action: Write `naming.rubric[]`, compute `naming.score` as the percentage of files passing every rubric line, and list every failing file in `offenders[]` with `reason` and `proposed_name`.
step.decision-gate: A score below 100 with no offenders is rejected (r-naming-clarity-score-lists-offenders).

step.name: find-inline-data
step.input: Components and route files; a grep for array or object literals longer than 20 lines.
step.action: List each component carrying a literal data block in `inline_data[]` with the number of lines it occupies; propose the `src/data/` target in the decision.

step.name: reconcile-claude-md
step.action: If absent, generate `CLAUDE.md` from the template. Read its max-file-size line into `claude_md.line_limit` and set `claude_md.present`.
step.decision-gate: `claude_md.line_limit` different from the `line_limit` input fails the audit; fix both in the same PR (r-claude-md-matches-audit).

step.name: decide-and-wire-ci
step.input: All audit sections; the CI pipeline definition.
step.action: Write `decision` naming every file to split, flatten, delete or rename in order: barrels and wildcards, then oversized files by size, then depth, then names and inline data. If every section is empty, the decision is to commit `CLAUDE.md` and add the audit command to the pull-request pipeline; set `ci_wired`. Set `review.cadence` and `next_review_at`; fill `templates/skeleton.md.j2`; run `scripts/validate-llm-friendly-architecture.py --file`.
step.output: Committed audit record; CI job once the baseline is clean.
step.decision-gate: A clean audit with `ci_wired: false` is rejected (r-audit-is-reproducible-command).

list.item: Every `oversized[]`, `barrels[]`, `directory_depth.violations[]`, `wildcard_imports.hits[]`, `naming.offenders[]` and `inline_data[]` entry is named in the decision.
`CLAUDE.md` exists and states the same line limit as the audit.
